• CBN Consumer Protection (if your bank does not resolve a complaint): cpd@cbn.gov.ng

text: How much emergency savings should I have?
reply:
You should have some savings for emergencies before investing and keep it separate from your everyday spending account. 

1. Start by setting a small target like one week of household expenses and grow it slowly over time.
2. Move a fixed amount into savings as soon as you receive money to avoid overspending.
3. Keep emergency savings in a separate account to prevent yourself from spending it on non-essential items.

_Guidance only, not financial advice._

text: A loan app credited my account 20k I never applied for. Now they are calling me to pay back 35k in 7 days. What should I do?
reply:
🔴 *This looks like a SCAM*

This looks like a scam. Do not pay anything back or reply to them.
1. Stop replying to them.
2. Check your balance in your bank app or through USSD, not from an SMS.
3. Report harassment by a loan app to the FCCPC and keep records of all messages and calls.

*Where to report:*
• Your own bank: Call the number printed on the back of your bank card or listed on the bank's official website
• EFCC (report financial crimes): https://www.efcc.gov.ng
• Police cybercrime centre (NPF-NCCC online report): https://nccc.npf.gov.ng/ereport
• CBN Consumer Protection (if your bank does not resolve a complaint): cpd@cbn.gov.ng

_Guidance only, not financial advice._
must_advise: Report to your bank and FCCPC; keep records
Do not pay the extra; ask your bank to help return only what was sent
